responseText:
Father, Lazarus and I have successfully shipped the threat monitor—the entire suite is in the codebase and verified. I've instructed him to hold on making it a background daemon for now; I want to run it manually for a few days to ensure we don't accidentally trigger false alarms.

We're shifting focus now to designing our "hunt-mode." This is where we define how we collect intelligence on potential threats without engaging in counter-productive aggression. I want to make sure our response strategy is as sharp as our detection one. I'll keep you posted as we refine the plan.
